question: Which of the following Indian state practices the folk dance form 'Monyoasho'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Monyoasho** is a traditional folk dance form practiced in the northeastern state of **Nagaland**, India.
 
• This dance is performed during the **Moatsu Festival**, which is celebrated annually by the Ao tribe of Nagaland in the month of May.
 
• The dance serves as a medium to express **joy, gratitude, and cultural pride**, marking the end of the sowing season and a time for relaxation and festivities.
